title: al-Iʿjāz al-bayānī li-l-Qurʾān wa-masāʾil Ibn al-Azraq: dirāsa qurʾāniyya lughawiyya wa-bayāniyya
author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
edition: Dār al-Maʿārif, 3rd ed., 1 vol (Shamela HTML export, numbering follows the print)

Part 1: the Qurʾān's bayānī iʿjāz, an inductive study of the openings of surahs, of word meanings (no two words synonymous) and of style; part 2: the questions of Nāfiʿ b. al-Azraq to Ibn ʿAbbās on Qurʾānic words, studied against Qurʾānic usage.
